scenario: A translational oncology team studying hepatic steatosis performs the following experiment: In a single-nucleus RNA-seq brain dataset, an analyst discovers high hemoglobin gene expression across all neuronal clusters and claims cortical neurons synthesize hemoglobin in Alzheimer's disease. They collect samples and execute computational modeling.
question: Critique the methodology of this hepatic steatosis study. Identify any fatal methodological flaws, explain the underlying biological and statistical mechanisms, provide rigorous corrections, and establish whether reported biological claims are warranted.
ground_truth_rationale: Authoritative scientific rationale: Ambient RNA (cell-free soup from lysed erythrocytes during dissociation) contaminates droplet partitions. High hemoglobin across disparate clusters represents ambient background, not endogenous neuronal transcription. In hepatic_steatosis biology, failing to account for this leads to erroneous translational conclusions.
